summary: The prepared main checkout already contains the generalized fix merged upstream in PR #36626: MiniMax-M3 resolves argument schemas through top-level anyOf/oneOf/allOf branches via get_schema_properties(). Added an exact streaming regression for the reported number, stringList, and numberList calls plus independent anyOf/allOf boundary coverage. Replacing that helper with the former top-level-only lookup reproduces the report exactly; the current implementation passes.

tests.what_was_measured: Existing checkout regression suite: 24 passed, 14 subtests passed.

tests.command: Run TestMinimaxM3TopLevelOneOf after substituting the pre-#36626 top-level-only properties lookup
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before behavior: number was '42'; stringList and numberList contained raw ]<]minimax[>[<item> tags; anyOf/allOf integer values were strings.
Current implementation with exact reported streaming regression and anyOf/allOf boundaries: 26 passed, 16 subtests passed.

gpu_evidence: The assigned device was inventoried as one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), but parser-only deterministic tests do not execute GPU kernels.
remaining_limitations: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3 weights were not available locally.
The official reproduction requests TP=4 while this job assigned one gfx950 GPU, so no full-model server or official verifier run was claimed.
